name: M3_OIS100MI_GetLine
description: Retrieve detailed information for a single customer order line. The response includes item identity and description, ordered and confirmed quantities, warehouse and delivery details, requested and confirmed delivery dates and times, pricing (sales price, discounts, net price), cost information, currency, order and line status, configuration and warranty data, references, and user-defined fields. The operation is read‑only and returns the current stored values for the selected line. A price formatting option lets you control whether sales price–related fields are returned per single unit or per sales price quantity, which is important for external publishing and integrations.

inputParameters.name: ORNO
inputParameters.description: Customer order number identifying the order to retrieve the line from.

inputParameters.name: PONR
inputParameters.description: Order line number identifying the specific line to retrieve.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company in which the customer order is registered; defaults to the user’s company if omitted.

inputParameters.name: POSX
inputParameters.description: Line suffix identifying the specific subline when the order line has multiple sublines, such as for kits.

inputParameters.name: PISQ
inputParameters.description: Indicator that controls how sales prices are published for the line; when set to 1, SAPR and NEPR are returned per sales price quantity, otherwise they are returned per unit.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number for the product on the customer order line.

outputParameters.name: ITDS
outputParameters.description: Short item description for the customer order line.

outputParameters.name: ORQT
outputParameters.description: Ordered quantity for the line in the item’s basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse from which the order line is planned to be delivered.

outputParameters.name: CUPO
outputParameters.description: Customer’s own order line number used as a reference to their order.

outputParameters.name: DWDT
outputParameters.description: Requested delivery date for the order line.

outputParameters.name: JDCD
outputParameters.description: Joint delivery code grouping this line with other lines that must be delivered together.

outputParameters.name: SAPR
outputParameters.description: Sales price for the line in the order currency, returned per unit or per sales price quantity depending on the priceInSalesQuantity (PISQ) input.
